title: Schedule discovery used a bare urlopen: one transient MLB error failed the whole data pull — on the 3am chain and on the live cascade's season refresh
tier_reason: no firing is evidenced in the repo; the exposed paths include the live lineup-check prediction (season refresh inside run_pipeline) as well as the 3am pull → build → preview chain, so a firing would be a liveness/delivery (A) impact, while none found leaves it latent — Route R decides

contract.text: Idempotent MLB statsapi GETs on the data-pull path retry transient failures (shared retry_urlopen: 3 attempts, linear backoff, no retry on 4xx), so one blip cannot discard a pull.
contract.source: src/bts/util.py retry_urlopen (the policy every other HTTP caller uses, per 950c081 body); 950c081

mechanism.text: discover_games walked the date range one day at a time with a bare urlopen, so any transient MLB error raised out of pull_feeds; the 3am cron's `bts data pull` (7-day window) then failed, skipping build, preview and R2 sync, and the live path — orchestrator.predict_local → run_pipeline(refresh_data=True) → _refresh_season_data → pull_feeds(season start → yesterday) — raised too, which predict_local catches as 'Prediction failed', leaving that lineup check with no predictions

watchdog.trigger: a lineup check whose prediction ends in 'Prediction failed' (or a 3am chain whose `bts data pull` exits nonzero) with an MLB statsapi network/5xx error as the cause, on a game day before the earliest cutoff
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a later check on the same day produces predictions and the day ends with a scoreable commit or a recorded skip; the 3am chain's next run completes pull → build → preview

evidence.what: discover_games walked the range with a bare urlopen, so one transient MLB blip threw away every day already fetched; the last unprotected fetch on the pull path; the body calls it 'Backfill-only path; the live pick pipeline was never affected'

evidence.locator: src/bts/model/predict.py run_pipeline/_refresh_season_data, src/bts/orchestrator.py predict_local, src/bts/data/pull.py pull_feeds at d3b2954 (= 950c081^)
evidence.what: the live prediction path refreshes the season via pull_feeds → discover_games with no guard around the refresh; predict_local converts the exception to None

Firing is unknown — Route R: scheduler journal 'Prediction failed' lines carrying urlopen/timeout/5xx errors (5/11 → 8/03) and cron.log 3am pull failures
